title: Ory's first band and how Murray fetched Louis Armstrong for Oliver's band
summary: Murray names Ory's first band members, then claims he got young Louis Armstrong to replace Joe Oliver, and that Paul Whiteman sent him for Louis in 1925.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Who was with Ori then? Ori?

Ori's first band. Ori's first band came here with Ori, was a fella by the name of Chiff. And his brother Stonewall. And Manuel Mineta, playing violin. And I just remember, Bob Lyons hadn't went with him yet. No.
Chiff was a Kornack player, Stonewall was a guitar player?

Yeah, his brother Stonewall was a guitar player. And Chiff was a trumpet player. And his first band came here. And then on, you know, different fellas, was a trumpet player. Well, uh... Really, the facts. You know, it's different things have come out, different papers have got their view on it. Now, uh, it's never, it's really if the truth is told, and it wouldn't do me, uh, some people tell things they hear, but I'm telling you what I know. Now, with Ori's band, when Louis became with Ori's band, I'm the man that went and got Louis. Joe Oliver quit on the corner of Padida and Franklin. He didn't have no trumpet player. Louis was nothing but a boy and was waiting for a man by the name of Spano who had a tunk at Franklin Street. And I told him, I said, if you go down there, we can get him to play. I know he can hold up. And I'm the one that went down there with him and got Louis to get working that band. See? So the truth has never been told. See, people tell us different things, you know, to go their way, but that's really the fact about it. Now, I was with him, playing up until, not playing with him, because I didn't get a chance to play with him. Get your chance to play with him again until Paul Whiteman sent me for him in 1925. I was in Chicago. See? Paul Whiteman sent me. He made one appearance. His boy singing then. That was his boy singing when he went to New York after Paul Whiteman left the Rainbow Garden. That was his boy's band. Well, after that, when I came on back down to New Orleans, I didn't see him anymore. See? Now, me and my wife, oh, we black are all raised up together. See? Come up together. Of course, she did more traveling and singing than I did. See? She worked with different shows like Florida Blossoms and different road shows, you know, and things.
